notes: New: Data Mine gear now comes in three rarity tiers — Common, Rare and Legendary — instead of one flat pool. Which tier you find is weighted by how deep you are: Rare starts showing up around depth 15-20, Legendary never appears before depth 25 and stays rare even past it.

10 new gear items across Rare and Legendary, with mechanics the game hasn't had before: Type Wards (reduced damage from one type), dodge/flee gear, a same-type damage bonus, and a DEF spike when HP runs low.
Thermal Core and Frost Core (the move-granting gear) moved up to the Rare tier.
